item.title: New school report revealed
item.description: The government has unveiled a new style of school report it says will give families clearer information about their children.

item.title: Rowing gold stolen from Olympian's home
item.description: A former Olympic rower hopes there is some honour among thieves after his gold medal was stolen from his Christchurch home while he was away for the weekend.

item.title: Minerals Council advocates more mining in NZ
item.description: New Zealand is in talks with the US about the supply of rare and critical minerals. Photo: Getty Images By Anneke Smith of RNZ The Minerals Council says New Zealand should open up to more mining, arguing it can be done responsibly.

item.title: Government reveals new school report
item.description: The government has unveiled a new style of school report it says will give families clearer information about their children.

item.title: Pike River criminal probe nears end
item.description: Twenty-nine men died in the blast or from the toxic atmosphere underground, while two others in the stone drift managed to escape in 2010. PHOTO GETTY IMAGES (file) Police are nearing the final stages of their criminal investigation into the Pike River mine disaster, in which 29 men were killed.

item.title: Expulsion of Te Pāti Māori MP breached process, court told
item.description: Mariameno Kapa-Kingi. Photo: RNZ (file) By Lillian Hanly of RNZMariameno Kapa-Kingi's lawyers claim Te Pāti Māori's co-leaders were projected to overspend their parliamentary budget, and there was discussion of a settlement proposal during a hearing to consider the Te Tai Tokerau MP's expulsion.

item.title: Interest rates relief for homeowners on way
item.description: Photo: RNZ By Susan Edmunds of RNZ Interest rates might have started to rise but what home loan borrowers pay in interest is likely to keep falling through this year.

item.title: Latino star Bad Bunny takes top Grammy
item.description: Bad Bunny receives Album of the Year award for Debi Tirar Mas Fotos. Photo: Reuters Bad Bunny, the Latino rap star whose forthcoming Super Bowl gig has ignited a culture wars controversy, has won the top Grammy prize - a first for a Spanish-language album, with Debí Tirar Más Fotos a celebration of his Puerto Rican roots.

item.title: Double glazed and dazed: Kererū injuries rising
item.description: The kererū is the largest pigeon in the world. PHOTO LINDA ROBERTSON/ ODT (file) A Dunedin wildlife hospital suspects modern windows could be to blame for an increasing number of serious injuries in Aotearoa's native wood pigeon/kererū.
